items.headline: Air Force QB Liam Szarka lost for season with lower leg injury
items.description: Air Force starting quarterback Liam Szarka will miss the rest of the season with a lower leg injury sustained in Saturday's win against Navy.

items.description: Air Force (3-1) at Northern Illinois (0-4), Oct. 10 at 7:30 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Alabama's jab at Mississippi State tops trolls from Week 5 college football
items.description: Alabama took to social media to needle its Starkville hosts, writing "Not enough cowbells" in reference to Davis Wade Stadium's famous noise-making tradition.

items.headline: Air Force beats Navy 14-9 to get jump on Commander-in-Chief's Trophy competition
items.description: — Liam Szarka rushed for two touchdowns and Air Force defeated Navy 14-9 on Saturday.
